summary: This work adds thorough correctness tests and gtest performance benchmarks around CMYK “swizzling” (the process of rearranging and converting CMYK print colors to display formats) and cleans up platform defines for Android. It also fixes a color-management bug where 16-bit float color data (f16) was being prematurely reduced to 8‑bit (u8) before going through qcms’s tetrahedral CLUT (a color lookup table used for accurate color transforms), which could lose precision. Together these changes give Firefox more reliable and measurable color conversions — especially important for images, printing, and any content where color fidelity matters — and make regressions easier to catch in future.
